review_scope: Read-only source and prior native evidence; no control build or browser load during producer timing

findings.description: Completed isolated material uses fully admitted shared prepared body for complete config/seed/source equality plus exact transform/properties and ordered permanent mask geometry. Semantic mask IDs are not pixel dependencies, and canonical identities remain per object. Object and per-presentation compositing remains ordered.

Aliases own separate recorded metadata, Material owns one pixel lease, final alias erasure decrements unique bytes, existing GPU epoch retains pending quota. Baseline/source/candidate assets distinguished via build-provenance; host-tree freeze alone is not build source.

Seven materialLifetimes variants currently produce coverage counts but no work/pixel assertions, so they cannot establish changed mask/seed/pose invalidation. Producer asked to strengthen these same variants after browser windows, no expanded matrix or SDK rebuild.

Zoom feedback captures onFrame only after all6 wheels/current camera/current canonical generation. It cannot prove earliest retained/LOD feedback. Proxy and capture timings must remain separately named; missing earlier feedback remains explicit.

stagedMaterial composition contains active mask and resets on growing active prefix. Under oversized working-set continuous Move can still lose partial composite progress. Producer confirmed and will report as remaining, no all-move-path closure claim.

PreparedBodyIndex consumer assertion allows canonical/direct/pixel reuse while preserving one body/no new hash compare checks and pixel equality. Fault tests now force cold miss under explicit original conservative profile instead of assuming warm reuse must allocate. First failed runs preserved.
